subject: Re: Interview today — request to move / alternative format
content:
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, GreenLine Recruiting <scheduling@greenline.io>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 07:18:00 -0800
Subject: Interview today — running into a conflict / train strike

Hi Marissa,

I'm really sorry for the late notice — there's a city-wide train strike announcement this morning and I also just received a mandatory consulate appointment confirmation for a visa interview that overlaps our 11:00am PST slot. I can try to make 11:00 but travel + the appointment make it unlikely.

Would it be possible to:
- move to later this evening (after 6pm PST), OR
- switch to an asynchronous recorded option (I can record a 40–50 minute screen-share + voice coding session and upload a link), OR
- move to tomorrow if none of the above work?

I really want to keep this process moving — apologies again.

Best,
Aisha

[Attachment: visa_interview_confirmation.pdf (pdf)]

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@gmail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, GreenLine Recruiting <scheduling@greenline.io>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 07:45:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Interview today — running into a conflict / train strike

Thanks for the heads up, Aisha — and no worries, I appreciate you flagging this early.

Options that work for us today:
1) Move to 6:00pm PST (we can ask the panel to shift, but might be tight).
2) Candidate-recorded option: record a 40–50 minute screen-share + voice walkthrough of the coding exercise (we'll provide instructions and a template). Interviewers will review and we can schedule a 20-minute live debrief the same day or tomorrow.
3) Push to tomorrow morning (I have availability windows I can propose).

Can you confirm which you'd prefer? If you go the recorded route, please let me know your available window to submit the recording (we'll give a 3-hour submission window).

I've looped in Lauren (hiring manager) to weigh in.

Thanks,
Marissa
Talent Acquisition | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

---
On Mon, Nov 20, 2028 at 08:10 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for flagging, Aisha — totally understandable. Quick thoughts from my side:
>
> - Live is preferable for the interpersonal portion but I don't want to hold things up for you.
> - If you record, we can split evaluation: 20m system-design (review notes from recording), 30m coding (recording). After reviewers watch, we can do a 15–20m live sync with one interviewer just to cover anything unclear.
> - If we still need more signal after the recording, I'll authorize a short take-home follow-up.
>
> Marissa — please preserve the existing calendar time as an option (candidate might still make 11), and post the recording instructions if we go that route.
>
> — Lauren
> Hiring Manager, Infra Tools
